headlines.title: Vali Cyber Announces New Integration with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM
headlines.summary: LAS VEGAS, September 02, 2026--Vali Cyber announces integration with CrowdStrike, bringing hypervisor security data into the Falcon Next-Gen SIEM.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike Expands OpenAI Partnership to Secure Codex Agents and Integrate GPT-5.6 Cyber
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) has expanded its OpenAI partnership to secure Codex agents with Falcon Guardian and bring GPT-5. 6 Cyber into the Falcon platform, extending its cybersecurity strategy deeper into enterprise AI deployment and AI-assisted defense.

headlines.title: Palo Alto Sinks 8% Despite 34% Revenue Growth, CrowdStrike Falls 3%, Fortinet Slips
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks crushed revenue estimates and still got punished, while peers with weaker numbers barely flinched. The gap between what bulls expected and what the company delivered reveals a fault line running through the entire cybersecurity rally.

headlines.title: ControlMonkey Extends Cloud Configuration Disaster Recovery to the Security Stack
headlines.summary: The new coverage for security tools makes critical configurations across CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks recoverable, with additional platforms coming soonTEL AVIV, Israel and NEW YORK, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ControlMonkey, a Cyber Resilience Platform for Cloud Configuration Disaster Recovery, today announced its expanded configuration backup and recovery for leading security platforms, starting with CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
